test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: From which country has the Indian constitution derived the feature of a Five-Year Plan?
solution:
The correct answer is **USSR**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Five-Year Plans** were first implemented in the USSR under Joseph Stalin in 1928.
 
• India adopted the concept of Five-Year Plans from the USSR to systematically plan its economic development.
 
• India's first Five-Year Plan was launched in 1951, focusing on agriculture
